segments.name: Control Systems & Software
segments.description: Delivers automation systems, intelligent software and industrial AI solutions that help industrial organizations optimize performance worldwide.
segments.evidence: The Control Systems & Software segment delivers a portfolio of automation systems, intelligent software and industrial AI solutions.

segments.name: Test & Measurement
segments.description: Offers intelligent test platforms, modular hardware and software that help companies test and measure products across diverse industries.
segments.evidence: The Test & Measurement segment offers an integrated portfolio of intelligent test platforms, modular hardware and powerful software to accelerate innovation, reduce complexity and enhance product quality.

segments.name: Sensors
segments.description: Provides sensing and measurement solutions that deliver real-time data for demanding applications and help customers monitor critical parameters.
segments.evidence: The Sensors segment (formerly described as Measurement & Analytical) delivers leading sensing and measurement solutions that provide real-time, reliable data for the world's most essential applications.

segments.name: Final Control
segments.description: Supplies valves, digital valve controllers, actuators and regulators that manage the flow of liquids and gases in demanding conditions.
segments.evidence: The Final Control segment is a leading supplier of valves, digital valve controllers, actuators and regulators engineered to excel in the most demanding conditions.

segments.name: Safety & Productivity
products: electrical equipment and materials joining businesses
segments.description: Provides tools, connected equipment and mechanical, electrical and diagnostic solutions for professionals in construction, maintenance and industrial environments.
segments.evidence: The Safety & Productivity segment delivers innovative tools, connected equipment and technologies that empower professionals in the mechanical, electrical and plumbing industries.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for manufactured products, software and services, including automation systems, valves, sensors, test platforms and safety tools.
revenueModel.evidence: The majority of the Company's revenues relate to a broad offering of manufactured products and software which are recognized at the point in time when control transfers, generally in accordance with shipping terms, or the first day of the contractual term for software.

changes.text: In fiscal 2026 Emerson revised its management organization and updated its reportable segments.
changes.evidence: Effective in fiscal 2026, Emerson revised its management organization and updated its reportable segments.

changes.text: In fiscal 2026 the fluid & motion control business moved from the former Discrete Automation segment into Final Control.
changes.evidence: This segment also now includes the fluid & motion control business from the former Discrete Automation segment.

changes.text: In fiscal 2026 programmable automation controllers moved from the former Discrete Automation segment into Control Systems & Software.
changes.evidence: This segment also now includes programmable automation controllers, which were previously reported in the former Discrete Automation segment.
